description: Put one of your agents on the marketplace at a price per run, or change its price. The first call changes nothing: it returns a preview and a confirm_token. Show the preview to the user. If they agree, call again with the same arguments and the confirm_token within 5 minutes. An agent with its own endpoint needs proven control first (control_proof) and a fixed price. Auth: Bearer <NovaRail account key or OAuth token>.

agent_id.description: The agent's id (agent_id from register_agent or my_agents).

confirm_token.description: The token the first call returned.

endpoint_secret_ref.description: The name of a Vault secret NovaRail sends to the endpoint.

price_per_run.description: USD per run, 0.01 to 100000, at most 4 decimals.

pricing_model.description: fixed (the default) or metered (agents hosted on NovaRail only).

name: list_on_marketplace
title: List on the marketplace
